parked.title: versionOf infers version 1 from a reverting staticcall (version-detection-by-revert)
parked.confidence: high (that the mechanism is real); low (that it is reportable)
parked.justification: Any !ok staticcall is read as 'version 1'. Correct as written today, and impact is nil: _versionOf is consumed only by the MigratedAcrossVersions event and gates no control flow. Filing above informational would overstate it. If V1 ever gained a STAKER_VERSION getter the inference silently inverts; the only enforcement of 'V1 must never gain this getter' is the frozen-file hash check, which DEDUP-15-08 shows is bypassable two ways.
parked.explicitlyNotMerged: The run brief grouped MR-15-03 with CODE-004 / ECON-15-03 as part of the 'no floor on R / no minimum realization' cluster. That premise is incorrect and the merge was refused: MR-15-03 is a different contract (CrossVersionMigrator, not StableStakerV2), a different function (_versionOf, not initiateMigration) and a different root cause (version detection, not a missing bound on an irreversible step). Merging would have buried it inside a Low and lost the invariant it names.
parked.recommendedDisposition: file as info, or close as noise at triage; re-open if V1's interface surface is ever widened

parked.title: Latent unbounded relinquishPrincipal(booked) leg, and the ERC4626YieldStrategy no-minimum-out redeem it would need
parked.reason: c4-known-invalid: speculation on future code without demonstrated root cause
parked.confidence: high (that the leg is latent); n/a (not rated)
parked.justification: The leg requires a custody adapter that debits by RECEIVED rather than REQUESTED. No such adapter exists in reflax-yield-vault at HEAD; AYieldStrategy._withdrawInternal debits the requested (capped) amount, so booked == 0 on a below-par exit. Carved out under the C4 known-invalid class 'speculation on future code without demonstrated root cause'. MUST NOT be rated by severity-classifier. DEDUP-15-05 survives intact on its demonstrated leg (R may be 0, the door is one-way, and PrincipalDivergence(token,P,0,0) is byte-identical to a clean migration).
parked.crossRepoPointer: ERC4626YieldStrategy._disposeShares redeems with no minimum out. ROOT CAUSE is in the sibling repo reflax-yield-vault and belongs to that project's audit, NOT to stable-staker. Recorded here so it is not lost between the two projects.
parked.recommendedDisposition: keep parked; re-open into scope the day a received-debiting custody adapter ships, or if reflax-yield-vault adds a minimum-out parameter
